01About this site

A personal space for my work, since 2026.

I started planning this website in April 2026 and created its current repository in September. It is where I keep a record of my work and share what I learn along the way.

My projects range from developer tools and programming languages to desktop software, Android applications and games. The project pages link to the repositories, where you can follow their development.
